why_isolated_environment_required: format_factory.safetensors's own pyproject.toml documents that the official 'safetensors' PyPI distribution's top-level import name ('safetensors') collides with this repository's own legacy shadow package of the same name at src/python/safetensors/ (GAP-017) -- co-installing the reference package into the shared dev venv breaks that shadow package's direct imports. This is why tests/python/safetensors/test_official_interop.py and test_obligation_bidirectional_interop.py fail with PackageNotFoundError in the shared dev venv: the reference package is deliberately NOT installed there. This report verifies compatibility in the isolated environment pyproject.toml itself instructs callers to use.

environment.install_method: pip install src/python/core src/python/safetensors (real wheel build, NOT -e/editable -- two of the four target tests specifically assert an installed package resolves under site-packages, which an editable install does not satisfy; verified this distinction empirically: the same install with -e produced 2/4 pass, the same install without -e produced 4/4 pass)
environment.reference_package_install: pip install safetensors==0.8.0 numpy pytest hypothesis

results.broader_suite_check: Full tests/python/safetensors suite run in the same isolated environment, excluding the 7 legacy shadow-package-only test files (test_safetensors_compat.py and siblings, which import the deprecated bare 'safetensors.*' shim and are out of scope for this shipped-namespace verification): 275 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed -- confirms co-installing the real reference package alongside format_factory.safetensors causes no collateral breakage for any shipped-namespace test.

verdict_scope: Verifies format_factory.safetensors round-trips losslessly through the official Hugging Face reference implementation in both directions (factory writer read by official parser; official writer read by factory parser) and that both distributions co-install and resolve to their own distinct, correct site-packages locations without collision. Does not verify performance parity, torch/numpy adapter interop beyond what test_obligation_bidirectional_interop.py already exercises, or any FF6 format other than safetensors.
